title: Add project layout picker and Save controls
body:
Build the Project-header Layout picker and visible Save button over the model/store/apply seams. Selecting a layout applies immediately; a non-exact Apply shows a short dismissible summary instead of a reconciliation preview.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-project-layouts-design.md (sections: Picker and Save, Applying saved layouts, Revert)
Blocked by: r9a5ju - Apply and revert layouts without replacing Content
Dispatch prerequisite: the spec must be committed and available in the worker checkout. This plan only creates Backlog cards; do not start later waves early.
Done when:
- Project-only entries/diagrams, Custom/Modified, Save/Save As, rename/delete, replacement and errors follow the spec.
- Every selection applies immediately. The summary lists substituted/opened/additional/unfilled items from the same validated reconciliation Apply used; Revert stays one click away.
- Revert, no-active-project state, compact/zoomed Project access, and preservation on canceled dialogs work as specified.
- Test assertable UI bindings first. Capture and inspect screenshots covering picker, names, the post-Apply summary, errors, Modified, compact/zoomed cases and mixed applied Content.
- LayoutStore (src/layout_library.rs) re-reads project-layouts.json on every call by design. Read it when the menu opens and after each write, and keep that copy; never call it per frame.
- Queue layout requests only against the Project being shown; a request queued on a hidden Project runs whenever it is next drawn (src/wm/layouts.rs).
- Add one show()-level test: queue an Apply, run a frame, assert the outcome and Modified; then close a window and assert RevertStatus::Invalidated. The show() drain and end-of-frame watch_layout_edits hooks are untested today.
- Add/update the feature doc. No Use for new Projects action (wave 6) and no inert Create action (wave 7).
Gate: Follow AGENTS.md and the build/validation/change-control references. Run cargo check --target-dir target/agent and cargo test --target-dir target/agent, plus focused behavior tests. GUI claims require inspected screenshots; process preservation requires manager/Inspection evidence.
